route.note: Down into the Pool of Ask'Ar
Ghamoo-Ra in the centre of the pool
Go down to the Moonshrine ruins (floor 2; stairway not marked)
Baron Aquanis (only for the Horde quest)
Back to the Moonshrine and east to Aku'mai's lair

pulls.note: Pool packs; break line of sight on the casters.
Murlocs in small groups, then Gelihast.

strategies.text: Only Trample, but very high armour: physical DPS should debuff armour, casters are unaffected.
Kill her two naga adds first (CC or stun). Forked Lightning hits everything in front of her, so face her away; Frost Nova and Slow follow.
Clear the room, then pull him. His Net roots for 10 s; he dies fast once his murlocs are gone.
Clear adds first; use the wall by the entrance to pull casters out of line of sight. Mind Blast on the tank and Sleep on random players (healers too).
No abilities; the danger is drowning. Pull him fast and kill him before breath runs out.
Click the four braziers one at a time; each summons adds. His Poison Cloud damages everyone in it every 5 s for 45 s, so move out. He enrages with Frenzied Rage (+75% attack speed); heal the tank.

notes: Six bosses have OpenMap (Encounter Journal) pins; Lorgus Jett (rare) and Baron Aquanis (Horde quest elemental) have no position. Old Serra'kis is fought underwater in The Forgotten Pool (floor 3). The map shows no stairway between floors, so transitions are estimates. Method says Aku'mai is reached through a side chamber past Kelris and describes four braziers in his chamber; the older Classic 'fire bowls' door puzzle is not confirmed for Forever, so it is not listed. Quest NPC Argent Guard Thaelrid (Horde, Blackfathom Villainy) is inside the dungeon, exact spot unknown. Alliance reach it by boat to Auberdine, Horde via the Zoram Strand flight path.
